title: Home 4
note: B2 leaf to the Travel 3 template, 2026-09-05. Home 3 (B1) owns tenant/lease/utilities/attic/renovate/mould - recap card names them; this is the fabric of the house and the tools that fix it. Family card: renovate->renovation, plumber->plumbing, drill and switch as verb=noun conversions. Pool-checked; mortgage/landlord/basement/heating/garage already taught and excluded.

cards.title: You already know
cards.note: Home 3 was renting and its problems: tenant, lease, utilities, maintenance, damp, mould, leak, plumber, decorate, renovate. Those words carry this unit's sentences. New here: the parts of the house you never learned to name, and the tools that fix them.
cards.note_cz: Home 3 bylo bydlení v nájmu a jeho potíže: tenant, lease, utilities, maintenance, damp, mould, leak, plumber, decorate, renovate. Ta slova nesou zdejší věty. Nové jsou části domu, které jsi nikdy neuměl pojmenovat, a nářadí, které je spraví.

cards.title: Build the family
points: Words you know grow into this unit's nouns.
**-ation** and **-ing** build two; **drill** and **switch** are the same word as verb and noun.
